component.name: ByteKeys
component.summary: Control your laptop keyboard backlight and RGB lighting

description.p: ByteKeys controls the keyboard lighting of Linux laptops: plain white backlights as well as single-zone, multi-zone and per-key RGB keyboards. It detects your laptop and keyboard automatically and configures itself.

ul.li: Brightness, colors, zones and per-key colors
Software effects for every keyboard and the keyboard's own hardware effects
Rules: dim on battery, turn off when idle, low battery and overheat warnings, Caps Lock indicator, schedules
Profiles you can switch from the tray, the command line or rules
Works with kernel drivers, common USB lighting controllers and OpenRGB

screenshot.caption: Lighting: live preview, modes and colors

description.p: First public release: automatic detection, modes and effects, zones and per-key colors, rules, profiles, tray icon, command line tool and background service.
